content: Task: anomaly detection on multivariate time series - find time windows where several jointly recorded signals depart from their usual joint behaviour; in machine condition monitoring (vibration, torque, current, temperature) such departures are often the first sign of a developing fault, before failure | requires: time-stamped signals, aligned, with enough normal history | produces: an anomaly score per window and flagged windows above a threshold, as early warnings | families: ML, DL (distance and density scoring, reconstruction error, sequence models) | metrics: precision and recall of the flagged windows, judged against labelled events, and detection lead time before failure
source_reference: Shared-layer source note, part 2 (Module 1 team, 2026-09-29), Task patterns: anomaly detection on multivariate time series
